sources.title: YouMind AI Image Prompts

subset.selection: First 20 records in upstream array order

limitations: Only one category sampled; not representative of the full corpus. Categories overlap upstream.
Original creator/model/social post URLs are absent from these upstream records and remain null; sourceMedia URLs are preserved and not downloaded.
No invented Chinese translations; promptZh is null.

sources.title: AI Visual Prompt Cookbook

subset.selection: First 12 styles sorted by upstream path

limitations: 12 real style.json files copied byte-for-byte; sample image URLs are derived only from existing source tree paths, images not downloaded.
Upstream MIT license explicitly describes repository structure and documentation; no blanket rights claim is made for reference artwork or third-party marks.
defaults use first upstream example plus shared style anchors; aspect ratio defaults to 16:9 as a documented workbench choice.

sources.title: PromptFill

subset.selection: First 12 templates in upstream config order; only referenced banks, first 8 options each

limitations: Real data path is public/data/templates.json plus public/data/banks.json; no JavaScript source evaluation.
Repeated variables can use indexed selections; normalized default uses explicit selection, then index 0, then first bank option. Full original selections preserved.
Media remain remote URLs; generation and full upstream UI behavior not bundled.
